scheme_name: West Bengal Artisans Financial Benefit Scheme: Support for Digital Marketing
other_conditions: Applicant must be an artisan or belong to any group of artisans of an industrial cooperative society
Applicant must be engaged in traditional craft/trade using hand tools, equipment, or small machines
Applicant must be enlisted in the State Portal for artisans & weavers
Applicant must be an Indian citizen and a permanent resident of West Bengal for the past 10 years
benefits_summary: Individual artisans receive ₹2,000, while industrial cooperative societies receive ₹10,000.
